Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
On the day of the 9th of February nine Methuselah gathered to fight it
out of control over Baltimore. Almost a month later I, Chronicler of the
Event, am finished penning down the results. Why it has taken such a long
time is a mixture of being lazy and buzy.

Before the final round, the Methuselahs battled out in three major bouts.
The bouts offered a lot of diablerizing. Followers of Set bled hard with
Presence while the Gangrel used Force of Will to hurt their prey. Blood
Brothers made sure pool was at a high level and a few Salubri made life
difficult for many. A Ravnos had things under control with Sensory
Deprevation and Konstantin roamed around and stole equipment. The
Toreador tried to take control by using votes and a Tzimisce stood
its ground as usual. The Malkavians did a bit of everything and
Gangrel/Grangrel Antitribu made combat perilous.

The bouts were very varid in their manner, some relied on stealth others
on strength.

The first rounds were divided in two tables, one five player table and
one four player table.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>* Miriam Benyon diablerizes Karl, gaining Catacombs and Bang Nakh.
>* Beatrice ousts Archibald
>* Sten ousts Mattias
>* An Embrace diablerizes Miriam and gaines the above equipment.

Catacombs should never have been gained from diablerie. In play, it's
considered a location, not equipment. It is burned if the controlling minion is
diablerized.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: Frederick Scott
Messages.Body:


I'm not seeing how you come to this conclusion. Agreed, Catacombs is a
location and cannot be taken by diablerie but I can't find any rules,
rulings, or card text which causes it to be burned if the vampire that
brought it in is burned, via diablerie or any other means. Doesn't it
just sit there, unpossessed but unmoved until stolen by another Meth,
contested, or burned by some action?

Fred

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He didn't refer to "the vampire that brought it in".

He referred to the "controlling minion". That is, the minion it is
on (the one being diablerized). (Catacombs is *on* the minion, right?
It isn't a location that is merely in play and "pointing to" a minion.)

"When a card is burned [...] other cards on it are burned." [1.1.2]

--
